copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.name: Copper Structure Retrieval for Bulk Modulus
copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.description: Retrieve structure of Copper and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

copper_potential_file_subtask_bm.name: Copper Potential File for Bulk Modulus
copper_potential_file_subtask_bm.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Copper for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

copper_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: Copper Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
copper_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Copper structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Copper, based on the given simulation parameters. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure.

copper_C11_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C11 Calculation
copper_C11_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small uniaxial finite strain ε<sub>xx</sub> to a relaxed copper structure while keeping all other strain zero. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation for each strained structure. and extract σ<sub>xx</sub> from the relaxed structure. Use the linear stress–strain relationship σ<sub>xx</sub> = C<sub>11</sub> · ε<sub>xx</sub> to compute the elastic stiffness constant C<sub>11</sub> of copper in GPa units.

copper_bulk_modulus_subtask_bm.name: copper Bulk Modulus Calculation via Voigt Approximation
